item.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
item.description: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.

item.title: The ‘Pain in the Ass’ Math That Could Save Vibe Coding From Itself
item.description: A new startup called &Truth is joining the race to automate formal verification, a painstaking process that uses math to prove software works as intended.

item.title: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
item.description: The French AI lab claims its latest release matches or outperforms even the best models from DeepSeek and Z.ai in coding and cybersecurity.

item.title: I Gave My Blood to the AI Death Clock
item.description: Death Clock promises to predict when you’re going to die and help you extend your time on Earth. After a month, I felt like it was sucking the life out of me.

item.title: I Put a Bunch of AI Agents in Charge of a Fantasy Soccer Team. They’re Not Better Than Humans—Yet
item.description: To experiment with AI’s predictive skills, I let Codex loose on a fantasy team. It tried to bench Erling Haaland at first, but it soon learned the error of its ways.

item.title: Macmillan Staff Say the Publisher Threw a Party for a Workplace AI Assistant That Was Later Killed
item.description: Workers tell WIRED that NOA—or “No Ordinary Assistant”—was unhelpful. Bestselling authors also say AI is ruining their relationships with Big Five publishers.

item.title: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
item.description: Human beings struggle with emergency communication. Chatbots can help—if people take them seriously.

item.title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
item.description: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.

item.title: Anthropic Says It Will Revolutionize Biology—Some Day
item.description: In breathless press releases and posts, the company has touted its models’ ability to deliver scientific breakthroughs. But its IPO filing taps the brakes on just how fast its AI will lead to big discoveries.

item.title: UK Home Office May Face Investigation Over Use of OpenAI Tech
item.description: A government watchdog is considering a probe into the Home Office’s use of ChatGPT technology to process asylum claims amid concerns over the tools’ accuracy and secrecy surrounding their use.
